topic.title: Position Sizing Starts With Risk, Not With the Lot Button

research.summary: Position sizing begins with how much risk your plan allows, not with the biggest lot size you can click. The same stop distance can create very different account impact at different position sizes. Learning the relationship between capital, stop distance, and exposure is a core trading skill. Bigger size is not the same thing as a better trade.
